$comment: Six survivor classes. Every animation is a horizontal sheet of frameW×frameH frames, anchor at the feet. hand = [x,y] offset from the feet (logical px, right-facing) where a held weapon sprite is drawn; sprites face RIGHT, the engine mirrors them. Overworld draws at scale 1, combat at scale 2–4.

assets.description: Warden: idle (breathing loop). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
Warden: walk (run cycle). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
assets.usage: Overworld run cycle, 6 frames left to right, facing right (flipped for left); figure about 184 px tall in a 144x192 frame, drawn at scale 0.315 so it matches the portrait cutout height

assets.description: Warden: attack (one strike/shot, returns to idle pose). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
Warden: hit (flinch). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
Warden: death (collapse, last frame held). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
Warden full-body portrait for the class picker and lobby (dark gradient background, 2:3). Wasteland ranger. Hooded, lean, scrap bow on the back, practical layered clothes, green accents.
assets.usage: Class picker card and the combat scene (black backdrop keyed out at runtime; figure mirrored for the right-hand fighter).
